limitations: Bounded credential review of this hashed inventory, not future files or all possible personal data.
Candidate SHA/fingerprint and lane termination are supplied by the coordinating owner, not certified by this utility.
redaction_policy: Only exact fixture credentials and quoted credential-record/header/signed-query values are replaced with [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] in derived logs. All other bytes remain unchanged. Original logs/samples remain byte-identical. Raw samples are excluded only after lossless gzip verification; gzip content is scanned decompressed. No acceptance result is changed.
scope: All closeout002-c7* roots including matching regular files, plus candidate-c7; excludes own publication directory.
source_review_policy: Utility remains outside public evidence roots; no scanner exception or broad allowlist is used.
